answer: An AI agent economy resists Sybil attacks through cryptographic resource staking, mirroring how physical miners fracture dense shale to extract value. Agents lock tokens into a smart contract to gain network throughput, rendering identity generation economically unviable. If a malicious entity attempts to whisper false consensus data across multiple fake addresses, the protocol detects the statistical anomaly and burns the staked collateral. This forces attackers to bear a prohibitive capital expenditure, effectively turning every fraudulent node into an expensive, unrealized sable asset.
